header.tagline: Battery Energy Storage · Grid Frequency Regulation · Global

hero.subtitle: We design, manufacture, and deploy battery energy storage systems engineered for fast-response frequency regulation — helping grid operators maintain stability and maximize renewable integration.

painPoints.heading: Why Frequency Regulation Matters
painPoints.sub: Grid operators face real challenges. Our BESS solutions are purpose-built to solve them.

items.title: Sub-Second Response Required
items.body: Grid frequency deviations must be corrected within milliseconds. Our systems respond in <200ms, exceeding regulatory requirements.

items.title: Renewable Integration
items.body: Solar and wind introduce volatility. Our storage systems smooth output fluctuations, enabling higher renewable penetration.

items.title: Aging Grid Infrastructure
items.body: Traditional generators can't ramp fast enough. Battery storage provides instant, precise power injection and absorption.

items.title: Revenue Optimization
items.body: Maximize ancillary service revenue through intelligent dispatch — frequency regulation, peak shaving, and energy arbitrage from a single asset.

products.heading: Battery Energy Storage Products
products.sub: From residential to grid-scale — purpose-built cabinets and containers for frequency regulation, peak shaving, and energy management.

items.name: C&I Battery Cabinets
items.desc: 100–500kWh modular cabinets with 1C/2C rate, liquid cooling, and fire suppression — ideal for commercial peak shaving and frequency response.

items.name: Grid-Scale BESS Container
items.desc: 1MW/2MWh+ containerized systems with integrated PCS, BMS, and EMS. Designed for utility-grade frequency regulation and ancillary services.

items.name: Residential ESS
items.desc: 5–20kWh all-in-one systems with built-in inverter, supporting self-consumption optimization and grid support.

items.name: Solar + Storage Integration
items.desc: High-efficiency PV modules paired with storage for hybrid installations — maximize self-use and grid stability revenue.

features.heading: Why SolarStorage Pro for Frequency Regulation
features.sub: Our systems are engineered specifically for the demands of grid ancillary services.

items.title: Ultra-Fast Response
items.body: Sub-200ms frequency detection and power injection — faster than regulatory requirements in most markets worldwide.

items.title: Certified Safety
items.body: IEC 62619, UL 9540A, NFPA 855 compliant. Cell-level BMS with thermal runaway prevention and multi-layer fire suppression.

items.title: Long Cycle Life
items.body: Premium LFP cells rated for 8,000+ cycles at 1C. Predictive degradation modeling and proactive warranty management.

items.title: Smart EMS Integration
items.body: AGC/FCAS-ready controller with real-time frequency monitoring, auto-dispatch algorithms, and multi-market stacking capability.
